name: Slipstream
description: Slipstream: a few words in a marked box that streak with speed lines and lean forward when you hover them.

props.name: children
props.description: The words to wrap. Keep it to a short phrase; it sits inline in your heading.

props.name: streaks
props.description: Number of speed lines that run behind the text on hover.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for an average line to cross the box. Each line runs a little faster or slower.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the speed lines, the trailing copy and the corner marks on hover.
